fields.Name: IT99 - Realtime Session Config Guard
fields.Description: Deterministic server-side bundle, sequence 49, ahead of the client-transport tests. The one in-process exception to the client-first doctrine: server-decided session state (identityVerification, maxSessionDeadlineIso) can only be written by trusted server code. RSG1 proves the owner's direct Save cannot forge it while a trusted write and ordinary Config edits work. RSG2 seeds the two sessions the wire bundle IT100 needs and hands their ids over. Requires RUN_MUTATION_TESTS because every check writes a tagged session fixture.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A direct Save cannot forge verification state or move the deadline; a trusted write persists; ordinary Config edits are not blocked; the wire bundle's server-decided fixtures are seeded.
